This is the audit-sweep ADVI_INFMVP F1 flagged (F1 fixed the first instance in PartnerAnalytics the same way). Phases: P0 (RD, empirical confirm + full _shared sweep, sizes W1/W2 + decides FE-only-vs-needs-AE); W1 (RD, resolve firmId-scoped gates from firmId, durable = SHARED.006 two-param useTenantLayout(firmId,firmOverride?)); W2 (RD FE + AE conditional, route firm-scoped data for external users). REGRESSION MATRIX MANDATORY across 49F/demo/internal (asymmetric bug).
